objective: Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.

description: I have cutting to do.  I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade.  A certain blade...
Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword.  I call it a swing blade.
You help me?  Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special.
But don't sleep on this.  What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
completion: That's a good blade. It has a good swing. It's a good swing blade. Thank you. Thank you, thank you, thank you!!! Now I want to try it....
Later. I'll try it later. But like I was saying... thanks.
